name: elastic-net-biomarker-panel
description: Use to select compact predictive biomarker panels with elastic-net or pure-LASSO logistic regression, nested cross-validation, stability selection, and independent-cohort validation.
default_message: Build a 5-15 gene biomarker panel from the MARS sepsis consortium whole-blood transcriptomics dataset (GSE65682, Affymetrix HG-U219) that classifies immunosuppressed Mars1 ICU sepsis patients against all other endotypes, using elastic-net logistic regression with nested cross-validation and stability selection, then validate the locked panel on an independent cohort. Generate a PDF report with intro, methods, results, conclusions, and figures from all analyses performed.
